mapper.select:
select sp.sale_price as sellPrice,sp.unit_price as unitPrice
,mgr.market_id as marketId,sp.category_id as categoryId
from spu sp
left join market_goods_relation mgr on sp.id = mgr.goods_id and mgr.user_id = #{channelId} and mgr.relation_type = 3
where sp.id = #{goodsId} limit 1
SELECT DISTINCT sp.category_id,sp.category_name FROM store_distribution sd INNER JOIN spu sp ON sd.goods_id = sp.id WHERE sd.store_id = #{storeId} AND sd.data_type = 0 AND sd.goods_state = 0

SELECT sd.id, sd.goods_id as goodsId, sd.sell_price as sellPrice, sd.sell_num as sellNum, sd.goods_state as goodsState, sd.supplier_price as supplierPrice, sd.goods_info as goodsInfo, sd.need_update as needUpdate, sd.up_time as upTime, sd.market_id as marketId, sd.unit_price as unitPrice, sd.create_time as createTime, sd.store_id as storeId, sd.channel_id as channelId, sp.name as goodsName, sp.img as goodsPicture, sp.virtual_sale_num as virtualSaleNum FROM store_distribution sd INNER JOIN spu sp ON sd.goods_id = sp.id WHERE sd.data_type = 0 AND sd.goods_state = 0 AND sd.recommendation_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sd.sell_num DESC LIMIT #{limitNum}

SELECT t.id, t.goodsId, t.sellPrice, t.sellNum, t.goodsState, t.supplierPrice, t.goodsInfo, t.needUpdate, t.upTime, t.marketId, t.unitPrice, t.createTime, t.storeId, t.channelId, t.goodsName, t.goodsPicture, t.virtualSaleNum FROM ( SELECT sd.id, sd.goods_id as goodsId, sd.sell_price as sellPrice, sd.sell_num as sellNum, sd.goods_state as goodsState, sd.supplier_price as supplierPrice, sd.goods_info as goodsInfo, sd.need_update as needUpdate, sd.up_time as upTime, sd.market_id as marketId, sd.unit_price as unitPrice, sd.create_time as createTime, sd.store_id as storeId, sd.channel_id as channelId, sp.name as goodsName, sp.img as goodsPicture, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.store_id ORDER BY sd.sell_num DESC) as rn, sp.virtual_sale_num as virtualSaleNum FROM store_distribution sd INNER JOIN spu sp ON sd.goods_id = sp.id WHERE sd.data_type = 0 AND sd.goods_state = 0 ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ORDER BY t.sellNum DESC LIMIT #{limitNum}
select sd.sell_num + spu.virtual_sale_num from store_distribution sd left join spu on sd.goods_id = spu.id where sd.id = #{distributionId} and sd.goods_state = 0 and sd.del_flag = 0

SELECT sd.id AS id, sd.sell_num + IFNULL(p.virtual_sale_num, 0) AS num FROM store_distribution sd LEFT JOIN spu p ON sd.goods_id = p.id WHERE 1=1
AND sd.id IN
#{id}
AND sd.goods_state = 0 AND sd.del_flag = 0
select SUM(sd.sell_num + spu.virtual_sale_num) from store_distribution sd left join spu on sd.goods_id = spu.id where sd.store_id = #{storeId} and sd.goods_state = 0 and sd.del_flag = 0
